ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 80:20 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface. High global contrast is maintained between the central pigmentation and the perimeter.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white central region. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edge and centered around the median notch. Three distinct circular black focal spots: two located in the mid-lower section of the left lobe and one in the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with a vertex angle of approximately 35-40 degrees. Depth of notch relative to fluke height is approximately 1/6th of total vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge. Visible pixel-amplitude variations (peaks) are most pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes. Significant jagged irregularity and tissue loss visible on the distal ends of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trajectory on the trailing edge moving from the tips toward the median notch; convex trajectory on the leading edges forming a tapered sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel clusters (spots) at relative coordinates [0.35, 0.55], [0.32, 0.65], and [0.65, 0.55]. Brownish-yellow organic clusters (likely barnacle colonization) at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, dark vertical and diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) present in the mid-upper regions of the left lobe, breaking the uniform white intensity.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Yellowish-brown organic encrustations and irregular tissue topography at both lateral tips; vertical linear scarring on the left lobe ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly unique tripartite 'face-like' arrangement of three circular black spots located on the left lobe.
